output.headline: Second-ranked buyer on the priority list: Southeast footprint, a prior Southeast dental buyout and an open platform add-on route for the $80M target.
output.differentiator: Most Southeast deals of any buyer on the priority list (6 of 15), plus an open platform route in the sub-sector and stated capacity for larger deals. [T:record, A:angles]
output.why_them: Southeast dental precedent, open platform add-on route, pays above upper quartile

acquirer_overview.title: Active sponsor with a provider focus and a mostly closed record
points: Financial sponsor with 15 deals from 2015 to 2024; 12 closed (80%), and 14 of 15 were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Median deal $187M, ranging from $9M to $994M; 5 deals since 2022 across 8 active years. [T:record, K:recent, K:years_active]
8 of 15 deals are provider services (2 dental, 6 adjacent). Fund size and firm profile not researched. [A:angles, T:record, R:FUND_SIZE_UNKNOWN]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A Southeast dental add-on for a sponsor that has bought there
points: Buying in this or a neighbouring region is a modest factor in its likelihood of 5.4%; 6 of its 15 deals are in the Southeast. [S:geo_fit, R:rank, T:record]
Bought Maple Dental Care ($428M, 2020) in the Southeast, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2020-0286]
Margin Improvement drove 5 of 15 deals; its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on. [M:margin_improvement, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Two dental deals and a recent Southeast bolt-on
points: Maple Dental Care: $428M Leveraged Buyout, Southeast, 2020, at 13.0x EV/EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2020-0286]
Great Medical Associates (physician groups): $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, Southeast, 2024, at 13.3x; Harbor PACE: $81M, 2019, at 16.1x. [D:MA-2024-0002, D:MA-2019-0271]
Core Oral Health: $12M dental Recapitalization, West Coast, 2022, at 16.1x. Only 3 of 15 deals sit in the $40M-$160M size band. [D:MA-2022-0428, K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible and within this buyer's habits
points: 63 comparable deals show 11.0x at the 25th percentile, 13.7x median and 15.4x at the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
Target margin of 18.0% beats the comps' 12.4% median and exceeds 92% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
Its median paid of 16.1x sits above the 15.4x upper quartile; at 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $53M. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask is 14.0%, against a 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 13.7x leaves the maximum price at $68M, no higher. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The $68M ceiling is below the $80M EV, so a price or structure gap must be bridged. [V:lbo, X:target]

risk_flags.title: Size and capacity
risk_flags.concern: Median deal is $187M and only 3 of 15 deals fall in the $40M-$160M band. [T:record, K:size_band]
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done deals as small as $9M, and Harbor PACE at $81M. [T:record, D:MA-2019-0271]
risk_flags.reality: Fund size not researched, so equity capacity is unconfirmed. [R:FUND_SIZE_UNKNOWN]

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: Share of deals that closed is a slight factor against: 12 of 15 (80%). [S:close_rate_s, K:closed_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: Both its Southeast precedents, Maple Dental Care and Great Medical Associates, closed. [D:MA-2020-0286, D:MA-2024-0002]
risk_flags.reality: Meridian Medical Associates (2022) was withdrawn; a diligence point, not a bar. [D:MA-2022-0056]

conviction.rationale: Two deals in the target's own sub-sector, six in adjacent provider sub-sectors, an open platform add-on route and a #2 position on the priority list support High. [C:conviction, R:rank]
